name: Student Feedback
description: Creates structured, actionable student feedback using the SBI (Situation-Behavior-Impact) model and other feedback frameworks for educators. Produces specific, growth-oriented feedback comments for student work -- not generic praise or criticism templates. Use when an educator asks to write feedback on student work, create feedback comments, provide constructive criticism, or design a feedback protocol for assignments. Do NOT use for grading rubrics (use `rubric-creation`), for assessment creation (use `assessment-design`), or for peer feedback frameworks among students (use `discussion-questions`).
